papers.title_en: A Visible-Frequency Excitonic Reststrahlen Band in (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ Slabs
papers.authors: Michael Pfeufer, Patrick Grenzer, Friedrich Schöppler, Tobias Hertel
papers.evidence: 强激子驱动实介电常数变负，揭示了介电常数近零转变
papers.tldr: 层状钙钛矿的强激子可重塑介电响应导致负介电常数，形成可见光波段的Reststrahlen反射带，但(PEA)₂PbI₄是否实现此机制尚不明确。本文通过低温透射实验和转移矩阵分析，观察到随厚度增加的透射光谱从激子凹陷演变为宽近零透射区间。结果表明(PEA)₂PbI₄薄片在可见光区存在负介电常数窗口和近超强激子-光子耦合，确认其为无腔激子Reststrahlen材料。
papers.abstract_en: Layered halide perovskites host exceptionally strong excitons, whose optical signatures are usually interpreted as absorptive resonances on a smooth dielectric background. Strong excitons, however, can also reshape the dielectric response itself and drive the real permittivity negative, opening a reflective band: the visible, excitonic analogue of an infrared Reststrahlen band. Whether bare (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs reach this regime has remained unclear. Here we show that low-temperature transmission of (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs, driven by the intralayer-exciton manifold, evolves with increasing thickness from an excitonic dip into a broad near-zero-transmission interval with compressed Fabry-Pérot-like fringes. Transfer-matrix analysis with an effective Lorentz-oscillator dielectric response reproduces this crossover, reconstructs a finite negative-Re($\varepsilon$) window, and implies near-ultrastrong exciton-photon coupling. Calculated field maps show suppressed in-plane field penetration within this interval and a driven longitudinal response near the high-energy ($\varepsilon=0$) edge. These results identify (PEA)$_2$PbI$_4$ slabs as a cavity-free visible-frequency excitonic Reststrahlen material.
